description: Show what a creator can claim and build the unsigned claim transactions: curve creator fees (New school coins, one vault across all the creator's coins) and, after graduation, each coin's Raydium CPMM pool creator fee. A New school creator's third of the locked-LP fees is paid by higher.fun off-chain; that is reported, not claimed. Set confirm_claim to true only after the user asked to claim. Returns a sign_url for the user's wallet when there is something to claim.

confirm_claim.description: Set to true only after the user asked to claim their creator fees.

wallet.description: The creator's wallet, which signs (public key only).

name: build_claim_creator_fees
title: Build creator fee claims (unsigned)
